messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick rundown of the long‑weekend holidays that Canadians celebrated in **2023**.  
(“Long weekend” means the holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, giving you a three‑day break.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Weekend that becomes a long weekend |
|---------|-------------|-------------------------------------|
| **Family Day** (Ontario, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Saskatchewan) | Monday, Feb 20 | Fri Feb 18 – Sun Feb 20 |
| **Good Friday** | Friday, Apr 7 | Fri Apr 7 – Sun Apr 9 |
| **Victoria Day** | Monday, May 22 | Fri May 20 – Sun May 22 |
| **Labour Day** | Monday, Sep 4 | Fri Sep 2 – Sun Sep 4 |
| **Thanksgiving** | Monday, Oct 9 | Fri Oct 7 – Sun Oct 9 |
| **Christmas** | Monday, Dec 25 | Fri Dec 23 – Sun Dec 25 |

> **Note:**  
> • New Year’s Day (Sunday, Jan 1) and Canada Day (Saturday, Jul 1) do not create long weekends because they fall on a weekend day.  
> • Remembrance Day (Wednesday, Nov 11) is a statutory holiday but does not create a long weekend.  

Feel free to copy this table into your holiday‑planning app! If you need the same info for another year or additional provincial holidays, just let me know.
